now.title: Black Widow
now.text: Alexei squeezes back into his old Red Guardian suit for the raid on the Red Room.

proposed.text: At Melina's farm, Alexei squeezes back into his old Red Guardian suit, and he is wearing it when Dreykov's agents take him to the Red Room, where he fights Taskmaster.

changes.evidence: Black Widow: Alexei finds the suit in a back room of Melina's homestead and tries it on there ('Still fits'); he is then captured in it and taken to the Red Room, where he faces Taskmaster. He does not put it on for a planned raid on the Red Room.
